ticker: Saudi Arabia overtakes UAE as India's No. 2 oil supplier
Trump, Xi, Putin sign historic trilateral peace declaration
South Korea hits $1 trillion exports on AI chip boom
COP31 draft climate agreement drops mention of fossil fuels
PM Modi urges India Inc to prioritize workforce compensation

articles.headline: Saudi Arabia overtakes UAE as India's second-largest oil supplier
articles.brief: Saudi Arabia has surpassed the United Arab Emirates to become India's second-largest oil supplier, while Russia retains its leading position in the market amid shifting global energy dynamics and trade routes.

articles.headline: South Korea hits $1 trillion in exports driven by AI
articles.brief: South Korea has officially become the fourth country globally to achieve $1 trillion in exports, fueled heavily by the ongoing global boom in artificial intelligence and semiconductor chips.

articles.headline: Lenovo posts 48% revenue jump driven by AI sales
articles.brief: Lenovo has reported a massive 48% surge in quarterly revenue, beating analyst estimates, as strong demand for artificial intelligence-related hardware and devices continues to drive growth across its product lines.

articles.headline: Trump, Xi, and Putin sign historic trilateral peace declaration
articles.brief: Leaders Donald Trump, Xi Jinping, and Vladimir Putin signed a joint declaration toward peace during a high-profile historic trilateral summit held alongside the APEC meetings in China, committing to major geopolitical pledges.

articles.headline: COP31 draft climate agreement omits any mention of fossil fuels
articles.brief: The revised COP31 draft climate deal released in Turkey has sparked intense debate by completely dropping references to fossil fuels, revealing deep divisions among nations balancing energy security against global warming commitments.

articles.headline: PM Modi criticizes industry leaders over lack of jobs
articles.brief: Prime Minister Narendra Modi delivered a blunt message at the FICCI AGM, pulling up industrialists for prioritizing high profit margins and failing to sufficiently expand the workforce or boost employee compensation despite recent tax cuts.

articles.headline: Amit Shah calls for international cooperation to hunt fugitives
articles.brief: Union Home Minister Amit Shah strongly emphasized the need for global collaboration to combat terrorism and organized crime, pushing for the extradition of dangerous fugitives hiding abroad during an anti-terror conference.

articles.headline: Gold prices recover from 14-month low amid Fed outlook
articles.brief: Gold prices managed to recoup some losses from a 14-month low, though a tighter monetary policy outlook from the US Federal Reserve capped potential upward gains for the precious metal.

articles.headline: EPFO approves systematic withdrawal plan for PF retirees
articles.brief: The Employees' Provident Fund Organisation has approved a systematic withdrawal plan to benefit hundreds of thousands of members aged 55 and above with substantial provident fund accumulations.

articles.headline: South Africa dethrones New Zealand in WTC points table
articles.brief: Following a decisive victory against Bangladesh, South Africa has surged to the top of the World Test Championship standings with a 75 points percentage, overtaking both New Zealand and Australia.

articles.headline: Shoaib Akhtar addresses historical ball-tampering allegations
articles.brief: Former fast bowler Shoaib Akhtar reacted to recent ball-tampering claims in cricket, asserting that various teams used unorthodox methods in past eras and urging observers to move past historic controversies.

articles.headline: Why data interoperability is critical to modern hospital care
articles.brief: Experts emphasize that the future of critical hospital care relies heavily on seamless data interoperability, determining how effectively medical information is connected, interpreted, and applied across departments.

articles.headline: Telangana sanctions thousands of new pensions for critical patients
articles.brief: The Telangana government has sanctioned thousands of additional Cheyutha welfare pensions specifically targeted at supporting vulnerable patients suffering from filariasis, AIDS, and ongoing dialysis treatments.

articles.headline: China's proposed tech export curbs threaten solar manufacturing
articles.brief: India is actively evaluating the potential impact of draft export restrictions proposed by China on solar manufacturing technologies, as domestic firms strive to meet ambitious renewable capacity targets by 2030.

articles.headline: Rockstar developers face layoff concerns after GTA VI launch
articles.brief: Despite building one of the largest and most expensive video games in history with Grand Theft Auto VI, developers at Rockstar Games are reportedly facing looming uncertainty and fears of post-launch layoffs.

articles.headline: India named top global travel destination for 2027
articles.brief: Following India being named the top travel destination for 2027, industry leaders have urged central and state governments to urgently establish hassle-free tourist circuits to sustainably handle the anticipated influx of visitors.
